full_prompt_en: A square decorative fantasy illustration shows a pale, long-furred fox-like creature in profile, surrounded by curling autumn leaves and circular line work. A thin double border encloses the image. The animal's head and upper body fill the central area, facing right. Long cream and sandy-white fur streams backward from the neck and ears in layered, ribbon-like locks, with fine brown lines describing every tuft. One amber eye looks ahead beneath a gently arched brow, and a dark slate nose marks the pointed muzzle near the right edge. The creature's front leg descends toward the lower left, partly hidden by broad leaves; the visible paw is softened into the ornamental undergrowth. Behind the head, a warm pale-gold circle is divided by sweeping arcs and muted gray-blue curlicues. The circle sits against a darker blue-gray outer ground, making a halo-like backdrop without a realistic light source. Large stylized leaves in ocher, apricot, tan, and sage curl up from the lower corners and along the left edge. Their veins are traced with delicate brown outlines and gently shaded interior planes. Smaller scrolls and layered fronds fill remaining spaces, keeping the image richly patterned but allowing the pale face to remain clear. The lower right leaf arches inward beneath the muzzle, visually balancing a larger folded leaf on the left. Color is subdued and harmonious, built from ivory, warm parchment, dusty blue, and faded autumn orange rather than brilliant saturation. Light appears broad and even, with subtle highlights on fur ridges and leaf folds; shadows are soft and embedded within overlapping layers. The finish resembles watercolor and colored pencil on lightly textured paper, with precise decorative contour lines. There is no readable text. The overall composition is ornamental and serene, balancing an alert animal profile with an enclosing rhythm of circles, flowing fur, and botanical curves.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性幻想插画呈现一只浅色长毛狐形生灵的侧面，周围是卷曲秋叶与圆形线条。细细的双重边框围住图像。动物的头与上半身填满中央，朝向右侧。长长的奶油色和沙白色毛发从颈部及耳后向后飘展，形成层叠带状毛束，细褐线描出每一簇。一只琥珀色眼睛从柔和拱形眉下望向前方，右缘附近的尖长口鼻上有深石板色鼻头。它的前腿向左下垂去，部分藏在宽大叶片中；可见爪子柔和融入装饰性低处植物。头后一个暖浅金色圆形被飞扬弧线与低调蓝灰色卷纹分割。圆形位于较深蓝灰外侧底面前，形成光环般背景，却不指向真实光源。赭、杏、浅棕及鼠尾草绿的大型风格化叶片从下方两角和左缘向上卷起。叶脉以纤细褐色轮廓描出，叶片内部色面轻柔塑形。更小的卷纹和层叠叶片填充余下空处，让图像图案丰富，却仍让浅色面庞保持清楚。右下叶片向内拱在口鼻下方，视觉上平衡左侧更大的折叶。色彩低调和谐，由象牙白、暖旧纸色、灰蓝与褪色秋橙组成，而非强烈高饱和。光宽阔均匀，毛发脊线和叶褶上有微妙高光；阴影柔和地嵌在重叠层中。成品近似轻微肌理纸上的水彩与彩铅，有精确装饰轮廓线。画中没有可读文字。整体构图装饰性强而宁静，以警觉的动物侧面平衡围绕它的圆环、流动毛发与植物曲线节奏。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration combines finely outlined organic curves with soft watercolor-like fills and colored-pencil hatching. Ivory, parchment gold, faded apricot, sage, and dusty blue-gray form a muted, harmonious range. Flowing layered shapes fan outward from a clear center, while broad circular arcs contain the movement and give it formal balance. Fine internal lines describe veins, strands, and folded ridges without turning the whole image into a hard graphic. Edges are most exact along focal contours and gently softened inside translucent shaded planes. Even diffuse illumination lets pale highlights and soft overlap shadows establish depth without dramatic cast light. A thin framing line and denser corner ornament create the feeling of a finished panel. The overall effect is elegant and calm, with meticulous line rhythm and restrained color making the surface feel hand crafted.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性插画把精细勾勒的有机曲线与柔和水彩般色面、彩铅排线结合。象牙白、旧纸金、褪色杏色、鼠尾草绿和灰蓝形成低调和谐的色域。流动层叠形态从清楚中心向外扇展，宽阔圆弧包住运动并给予形式上的均衡。纤细内部线条描出脉络、丝状痕迹与折叠脊线，却不让整幅画变得坚硬图形化。视觉焦点轮廓处边缘最精确，透明阴影色面内部则轻轻柔化。均匀漫射光让浅色高光和柔软重叠阴影建立深度，没有戏剧性投光。细边框线与角落更密集的装饰营造完成画板的感觉。整体效果优雅而平静，精密线条节奏和克制色彩使表面显得手工制成。
theme_en: A pale fox-like creature within a circle of curling autumn leaves
theme_zh: 浅色狐形生灵置于卷曲秋叶圆环之中
name: Jody Bergsma
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
